head_commit.message:
pm-270/t-1606: Flush gate-closure child output and settle ledger phone layout

lib/gate-closure.test.ts: children exit from stdout.write's callback, so
output is flushed. 200k must come back whole; 200k h + 1M t must be cut to
exactly 1,000,000 with the head dropped. The old immediate exit lost output
(146176 of 200000, 3/3), which is the only reason the old assertion passed.
With KEEP_CHARS mutated to 2M the new test fails. realRunChild is unchanged.

e2e/ledger.test.ts: the phone test now waits, with a bound, for visible,
nonzero and two-frame-stable scroller/sheet geometry before the unchanged
overflow and scroll asserts. Every message carries the viewport, widths,
min-width, font, readyState and up to 40 frame samples. New real-browser
controls: a frame shown 400 ms after hydration must be waited for, and a
sheet without its 46rem minimum must fail the scroll assertion. No CSS
change and no quarantine.

Verification: trace 5/5; lint/types exit 0; npm test 2370/2370; e2e x3
(scripts/e2e-local.sh, full build each) 3/3, each 179 pass / 0 fail /
1 existing skip.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
